title: M7-06 — sandbox smoke for session_start/session_stop/capabilities v2 wrappers + M7 close

shipped_artifacts.close_report: docs/milestones/m7-close-report.md (104 lines, 7 sections: executive summary, cycle log, v2 surface inventory, v1 deprecation bookkeeping, architectural decisions log, test pyramid state, m8+ handoff)

follow_up_in_cycle_fixes.trigger: Initial smoke revealed two architectural bugs in the m7-05 dispatcher+wrapper pair

bug_1_session_stop_double_call.summary: v2 session_stop wrapper used to call dispatcher's stop (which called ProbeService::stop and discarded events) then re-call ProbeService::stop to recover events for build_and_store_engine. The second call returned ProbeNotFound (probe already gone) so build_and_store_engine was silently skipped.
bug_1_session_stop_double_call.fix: Pre-stop the probe ONCE in the wrapper, persist via save_session + build_and_store_engine, then call the dispatcher for the seal/drain housekeeping. Dispatcher's internal ProbeService::stop is now tolerant: if it returns ProbeNotFound, it falls back to load_session() and synthesises the snapshot from the persisted metadata + event count.

bug_2_mark_sealed_required_session_in_st.summary: When seal_tail=true is requested for a session that has not yet been persisted to the store (live-only), mark_sealed.load_session returned SessionNotFound and the whole stop call errored out.
bug_2_mark_sealed_required_session_in_st.fix: mark_sealed now returns Ok(bool) — Ok(true) when the session was persisted and updated, Ok(false) when it wasn't (live-only). The dispatcher ignores the bool and still populates sealed_at in the response.

bug_3_capabilities_session_for_live_sess.summary: capabilities{session_id} read from the store but live sessions are only in live_probes. Test failure: `capabilities session failed: Session not found`.
bug_3_capabilities_session_for_live_sess.fix: capabilities_with_context now falls back to live_probes when load_session fails, synthesises a stub SessionMetadata from LiveProbeSession fields, and returns the dynamic capability snapshot.

architectural_decisions.pre_stop_then_dispatch_in_wrapper: ProbeService::stop is called once in the wrapper (before the dispatcher) so build_and_store_engine has the events it needs. The dispatcher is then a metadata-layer pass that drains subscriptions, seals the tail, and returns the final capability snapshot.
architectural_decisions.wrapper_persists_to_both_stores: After pre-stop, the wrapper calls save_session (redb store, for session_start{action=load}) AND build_and_store_engine (in-memory QueryEngine, for query_* tools). Same dual-write pattern that v1 probe_stop uses for the in-memory engine, plus a new redb write to make the session queryable via session_load.
architectural_decisions.save_session_metadata_is_minimal: For the v2 wrapper-driven persist path we set created_at=0 and duration_ms=0 — these are filled in by the dispatcher's load_session round-trip on subsequent calls. m7-07 followup can refine to wall-clock timestamps.
architectural_decisions.live_probes_fallback_in_capabilities: capabilities{session_id} resolves live-only sessions via live_probes lookup. Synthesised metadata has zero counts so the snapshot reflects 'session exists but no events yet'. m7-07 followup can extend SessionMetadata with a live_event_count field to avoid the 0 placeholder.
architectural_decisions.mark_sealed_tolerant_of_live_only: mark_sealed returns Ok(false) instead of erroring. Caller treats both Ok(true) and Ok(false) as success.

test_plan_completed.test_helper_gotcha: build.rs fixtures include test_exit_immediate and test_busyloop but NOT test_echo. Always use real fixture names from build.rs::build().

gates.T4_smoke_sandbox_probe_lifecycle_session: pass (5 + 8 + 11 = 24 smoke tests, --test-threads=1, ~167s wall; pre-built binary at /var/home/rubentxu/cargo-targets/debug/chronos-mcp; CHRONOS_MCP_PATH exported)
gates.behaviour_change: v2 session_stop now persists events to redb (required for session_start{action=load}); v2 capabilities{session_id} resolves live-only sessions via live_probes; v1 probe_stop semantics unchanged
